headline: Mini lane joins the game queue
lede: The studio's smaller-model QA lane no longer idles while games wait in the queue: the warden now sends mini to the oldest claimable queue item when feedback is empty and the lanes ahead have taken theirs.

notes.text: #1290 shipped (#1371): mini earns queue sessions one step behind studio QA — and the 48h fleet trial report now splits ships by lane lineage, so mini's output sits on its own line for comparison.

The ordering lives in the pure planner (lanes.mjs): mini takes the queue only when items survive the builders' slots and studio's share; if studio can't run, mini absorbs its share. Claim-time collision safety (#878) unchanged.
16 new lanecheck gates (now 66, all green) pin the matrix, and a verified mutant reddens three of them when studio's reserve is deleted — the harness can still fail.
Also on the board: talk-me-down's contract breakage (#1362) fixed by the QA lane, and a follow-up filed so mini inherits the flagship-gap fallback too (#1372).
